title: Full-stack optimizations for agentic inference with Dynamo
gist: The agent harness passes per-request hints down to the serving stack: priority, expected output length, and a signal to warm a worker while a tool call is in flight. The router places requests using a global index of cached blocks, and eviction can follow priority instead of plain recency.
changes: A different route to workload awareness: the workload tells the stack about itself, instead of the stack inferring it. If this interface standardises, per-user adaptation needs no private traffic analysis at all.
caveats: Undated. Hardware unspecified, and several features are described as being built. The cache-hit figures quoted come from a managed API, not from Dynamo.

numbers.metric: Median TTFT with a custom router that learns by sampling

bears_on.note: Hints about each request's shape change how it should be scheduled.
Per-request hints give per-user adaptation without building anything per customer.
